original.target_description: Original full text could not be acquired; supplied locator p. 5 cannot be independently checked. Replication report identifies the focal claim as the indirect effect of contingent reward on employee OCB through trust.

replication.target_description: Stage 1 replication; Model A SEM indirect effect of contingent reward behavior on employee organizational citizenship behavior via trust, without direct leader-behavior paths to OCB.

n.sample_role: participants in the Stage 1 SEM target sample
n.location: p. 1, Replication result: Stage 1, Main analysis
n.quote: Structural equation modelling was conducted with the Stage 1 target sample of 170 participants.

p.location: p. 1, Main analysis, Model A indirect effect

reported_success.quote: This effect replicates the effect reported in the original study (it is in the same direction as the original).

notes: Replication URL identifies the Stage 1 report. Requested replication metric ser_method is not a printed effect-size label; extracted the printed unstandardized indirect effect b. Also printed standardized indirect effect β = 0.60. Alternative Model B has a different indirect-effect test (p = .094); values were not combined. Original full text unavailable from the attempted open-access routes. DOI title verified via DOI landing metadata, OpenAlex and Unpaywall. OpenAlex and Unpaywall list no open-access full text; the indexed author repository redirects to a generic service page. Publisher preview and abstract were not treated as full paper evidence, and its generic sample was not extracted as analytic n. Original statistics mentioned in the replication were not substituted for independent original extraction. An initial web search incidentally surfaced an excluded-domain search snippet; that site was not opened and its contents were not used for extraction.
